posts.name: Jagruti
posts.cooked: I faced issues with vm throughout the oppe. I was continuously logged out from oppe and repeated had to login with ssh.

posts.name: Arpit Mishra
posts.cooked:
I am repeat OPPE student.

Due to continuous vm disconnection issue. I was not able to solve any question.

I think if my vm had been smooth, i must have solved the sed and awk question after debugging and investing proper time on it.

Please suggest some content and fixed resources to pass the ReOPPE.

I really don’t want to repeat the entire course again.

And if possible please take one or two sessions to assist student like us to pass the 2nd OPPE.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
The VM wasn’t having any issues. It seems to be a problem with your network. Yes, your network might be fast but some networks block ssh. So, it’s better to have a different network ready.
